free.a: Yes, 100% free. No hidden fees, no ads, and no usage time limits.

offline.a: The app stores data on your device. When online, data automatically syncs to cloud for backup.

data.a: Data is encrypted and stored on secure servers. You can backup and restore anytime.

export.q: Can I export data to Excel?
export.a: Yes. All sales, inventory, and debt reports can be exported to Excel/CSV format.

multi.q: Can it be used on multiple devices?
multi.a: Currently one account for one device. Multi-device feature will be available in premium version.

support.a: Contact us via email or WhatsApp. Support team will help within 24 hours.

language.a: Yes, the app is fully available in Indonesian. Also available in English.
